headlines.title: Harry and Meghan set to return to UK
headlines.description: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex are expected to move back to the UK. The Telegraph newspaper reports that six years after they stepped down as working royals, they will make the UK their primary base with their children. NBC News’ Daniele Hamamdjian has more.

headlines.title: Police seen at family home of men who were with Hayden Panettiere when she died
headlines.description: Police seen at family home of men who were with Hayden Panettiere when she died New video shows Greenville police responding to the family home of Brian Hickerson and his brother Zach, who were with the actress when she died. NBC News’ Steve Patterson has the latest on the investigation.

headlines.title: How Sen. Darline Graham’s debate blunder could give undecided voters ‘some pause’
headlines.description: Shelby Talcott, Steve Ricchetti and Ashley Davis join the Meet the Press NOW panel to discuss Sen. Darline Graham’s (R-S.C.) debate performance and key gaps in national security expertise compared to her late brother Sen. Lindsey Graham (R-S.C.).

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: Safari helicopter crash in Kenya kills 7, including Telemundo executive
headlines.description: A pilot and six passengers were killed when a helicopter crashed near Mount Ololokwe in Kenya’s Samburu County. Five Americans were on board, including José Suárez, a longtime Telemundo executive. NBC News’ George Solis reports.

headlines.title: ICE electric gloves already being used in schools
headlines.description: Parents in one community were surprised to learn the shock gloves soon to be used by ICE officers have been used in schools. Police say they won't use them after backlash and a request from the district superintendent. NBC News' Julia Ainsley reports.

headlines.title: More than 80 million Americans under heat alerts
headlines.description: That unrelenting summer heat is now bringing new storms to millions. With students going back to class, what are schools doing to keep them safe? NBC News’ Priscilla Thompson reports.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Pilot killed, 2 state troopers hurt after small plane and helicopter collide in Pennsylvania
headlines.description: A state police helicopter and a small plane collided over Carlisle Airport in Carlisle, Pennsylvania, Wednesday night, resulting in the death of the plane’s pilot, officials said.

headlines.title: U.S. will seek to deport captain of boat that capsized in New York, killing mom and baby
headlines.description: Prosecutors allege Manuel Hernandez was illegally operating the boat at the time of the accident. The Department of Homeland Security said he is in the U.S. illegally.

headlines.title: Two students killed, driver charged after crash into Tennessee college cycling team
headlines.description: Milligan University sophomores Haylan Engdahl and Brayden Rogers were killed and seven other college cyclists were injured in the crash on Highway 19 in Carter County.

headlines.title: Mike Lindell says he’ll pay for recount after loss in Minnesota governor primary
headlines.description: The MyPillow founder is prepared to pay nearly $1 million to cover the costs associated with a hand recount after he lost to state House Speaker Lisa Demuth.
